verdict.rationale: Qodo's Agentic Toolbox documents first-party plugins for Claude Code and Codex that explicitly cover resolving code review findings. An MCP server also lets any agent retrieve and resolve review findings, and findings can be fixed directly in the PR. This is clean, direct agent integration, which satisfies the story's 'or' condition. Missing for 10: explicit Cursor integration (only reachable via generic MCP), copyable per-finding fix prompts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent handoff flow.
